name: Fade In
framework_notes: Opacity 0→1 only, no translation. Use for tooltips, dropdown menus, and any frequently-repeated micro-interaction where motion should be nearly invisible.

name: Fade + Rise 4px
framework_notes: Opacity + 4px translateY, barely perceptible. Good default for list items appearing and toast notifications.

name: Color/Border Transition
framework_notes: CSS transition on background-color/border-color only, for hover and focus states. Framework-agnostic (plain CSS transition, no JS needed).

name: Scale on Press
framework_notes: scale(0.97) on :active, reverting on release. Communicates tactile feedback without feeling decorative.

name: Fade + Slide 16px
framework_notes: Standard panel/modal entrance. In React, motion/framer-motion's AnimatePresence with initial/animate/exit covers enter+exit symmetrically.

name: Staggered List Reveal
framework_notes: Each item fades+rises with an 30-50ms stagger delay. Cap total stagger under ~400ms so long lists don't feel sluggish; disable stagger past ~12 visible items.

name: Height Expand/Collapse
framework_notes: Animate max-height or use a measured-height approach (ResizeObserver) rather than height:auto, which cannot be transitioned directly in CSS.

name: Route Cross-fade
framework_notes: Outgoing view fades out while incoming fades in with a slight overlap. Keep under 250ms total or navigation starts to feel laggy rather than smooth.

name: Indeterminate Progress Sweep
framework_notes: Looping bar/spinner animation for loading states of unknown duration. Loop duration itself, not entrance duration — keep the sweep itself under ~1.5s per cycle.

name: Shared Element Transition
framework_notes: A card morphing into a detail view (layoutId in Framer Motion / View Transitions API on web). High payoff for showcase/gallery products, expensive to get right — budget real implementation time.

name: Scroll-Linked Parallax
framework_notes: Background/foreground layers move at different scroll rates. Reserve for marketing/showcase hero sections only — never on data or form-heavy screens; must respect prefers-reduced-motion by disabling entirely.

name: Spring-Physics Drag & Release
framework_notes: Draggable cards/sheets that settle with spring physics rather than fixed-duration easing. Use a physics-based animation library (Framer Motion's useSpring, React Spring) rather than hand-rolled requestAnimationFrame.

name: Orchestrated Multi-Element Page Entrance
framework_notes: Hero, then subhead, then CTA, then supporting art each animate in sequence with individual delays. High visual payoff for a landing/showcase first impression; never apply to a returning-user's dashboard home screen.
